name: Tablet mode (v4, Material)
author: Henri Schulz
description: Tablet mode v4: the Material home screen of lab/mui-material (an Android/Pixel launcher on a configured Material theme with Velum influences: Roboto, page dots, hotseat, search bar, long-press menus, drag with Remove / Uninstall and Undo, folders, page breaks) over v3's home indicator gestures, cards, App Switcher and window bar. IPC target henri.tablet4. Active while the Velum setting "tablet" is on (`tablet-mode on`).
